findings.highlight: I was wrong to think I could change anything.
findings.evidenceJa: —どうにかなると、判断した事が間違いだった。
findings.governingReading: His error was judging that the planned dash, hand-grab and sideways jump could somehow work.
findings.explanation: A mistaken tactical estimate becomes belief that he could change anything.

findings.highlight: swallowing every last prey within its web.
findings.evidenceJa: 蜘蛛の巣にかかった獲物を、容赦なく呑み込んだ。
findings.governingReading: The Shadow mercilessly swallows prey caught in a spiderweb-like situation; metaphor does not enumerate victims.
findings.explanation: A single prey in a web becomes every last prey.
